Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The chapter opens with statewide alcohol crash statistics; they are changing yearly figures and were left out of the fact blocks rather than taught as fixed facts [A01].
The offense penalty lists print jail terms and fines without saying whether they are maximums; the dossier keeps the list wording (a penalty listed as) and does not add up to or minimum (verify MN-IMPAIRED-D-PENALTY) [A04].
Commercial license alcohol rules are kept as continuation facts in part C2 because they are printed in this chapter, although the Class D written test centres on the regular license.
The cannabis rules list several product names exactly as the manual groups them; the dossier does not define those product categories beyond the page text [A06].
Fees, fines and penalty periods are isolated as dynamic facts in part C.
